name: Solange Beaufort
source:
A noble woman, raised with high expectations as the heiress to an estate in decline. Always distant from her family and forced to play the role, she never thought she'd be allowed to express her real feelings.

However, during the first snow the kingdom ever got, she met Eirwin, who listened to her woes and spent days with her, getting to know each other. Yet, in the end he disappeared.

She never forgot about him, and dearly wished to see him again. But after so many years, she wondered if it was foolish to still hope.

[From [url=https://floramisu.itch.io/a-wish-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
